controls.requirement: The provider and server-side ledger are authoritative; the client cannot mint purchases, currency, inventory, or entitlements.
One logical purchase produces at most one charge and one entitlement across concurrency, retries, and duplicate notifications.
Pending, success, cancellation, renewal, expiration, refund, revocation, restore, and family/account transfer behavior is tested.
Provider events and the internal ledger reconcile with durable discrepancy handling and human-owned financial actions.
Receipt/transaction verification, replay resistance, fraud signals, rate limits, authorization, and audit trails are proven.
Product configuration, real billing, charges, refunds, voids, grants, reconciliation, and customer communication require scoped human approval.
